children: AMERICAN BATTERY TECHNOLOGY Co reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $21.7M, up from $4.3M a year earlier, while net loss attributable to common stockholders widened to $(73.4M) and diluted loss per share remained $(0.58) for the year — according to the company's 10-K summary.
Revenue: $21.7M for FY 2026, up from $4.3M in FY 2025 (407% YoY).
Net income: Net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(73.4M) for FY 2026 vs. $(46.8M) for FY 2025 (worsened by $26.6M, (57%) YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.58) per share for FY 2026, unchanged from $(0.58) in FY 2025.

Revenue growth was driven by ramped recycling throughput and higher product prices as the company's first integrated lithium‑ion battery recycling facility began commercial operations and increased volumes since Q4 FY2024.
The company was awarded a DOE $150M grant to build a 100k tpa recycling facility and is pursuing site selection in the southeastern U.S.
Progress on lithium resources: a published PFS for the Tonopah Flats claystone project (Sep 2025) estimated ~21.3M t LHM resource and 2.7M t reserves.
Technology and funding momentum included multiple competitive DOE grants and 48C tax credits to scale claystone‑to‑LHM demonstration work and next‑generation separations technology.
